decision_rules.superiority: Holm-adjusted one-sided p <= alpha and GMR <= gmr_max (E2: and every evaluable guard holds); with both groups, no claim if the transfer group's 95% CI lies above 1
decision_rules.noninferiority: Holm-adjusted one-sided non-inferiority p (H0: GMR >= 1 + delta) <= alpha (prereg addendum 1); the unadjusted one-sided 95% upper bound is reported

E1.decision_rule: Holm-adjusted one-sided p <= alpha and GMR <= gmr_max (E2: and every evaluable guard holds); with both groups, no claim if the transfer group's 95% CI lies above 1
E1.wording: no detectable gain from reuse on tuned cores

E2.decision_rule: Holm-adjusted one-sided p <= alpha and GMR <= gmr_max (E2: and every evaluable guard holds); with both groups, no claim if the transfer group's 95% CI lies above 1

E3a.decision_rule: Holm-adjusted one-sided non-inferiority p (H0: GMR >= 1 + delta) <= alpha (prereg addendum 1); the unadjusted one-sided 95% upper bound is reported

E3b.decision_rule: Holm-adjusted one-sided non-inferiority p (H0: GMR >= 1 + delta) <= alpha (prereg addendum 1); the unadjusted one-sided 95% upper bound is reported
E3b.wording: non-inferiority to tuned TabM not shown at delta = 0.1: GMR 0.987 [95% CI 0.855, 1.138], one-sided 95% upper bound 1.111

definitions.log_loss: test log loss of the arm's own predicted distribution: adapted neural-CBR arms' test_L_post (cross-entropy of softmax(kappa * s), the distribution test_ece_post measures, argmax = accuracy_post); retrieval-only's test_loss_pre (NLL of the retrieved class mass p0 smoothed by 1e-8, so a zero mass on the true class costs about 18.4); baselines' receipt test_metrics.loss (sklearn log_loss, probabilities clipped at 1e-12)
definitions.log_loss_T: adapted neural-CBR arms' test_nll_post_T: the same logits divided by one temperature fitted on the validation stream (the distribution behind ECE_T; argmax unchanged); retrieval-only and the baselines record no temperature-scaled output
definitions.macro_f1: unweighted mean of per-class F1 over the classes in the targets or predictions (sklearn's macro average), from per-example test predictions: neural-CBR runs' retrieval_events.jsonl (final_prediction; pre_adaptation_prediction for retrieval-only), baselines' test_predictions.pt (argmax); a seed is used only if its predictions reproduce the recorded accuracy
